models.name: qualtrics__survey
models.description: Detailed view of all surveys created, enhanced with distribution and response metrics.

columns.name: survey_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for this survey. Match pattern = ^SV_[a-zA-Z0-9]{11,15}$

columns.name: survey_name
columns.description: Name of the survey.

columns.name: survey_status
columns.description: The distribution status of the survey, or a flag indicating that it's a library block. Allowed values - Inactive, Active, Pending, LibBlock, Deactive, Temporary

columns.name: brand_base_url
columns.description: Base url for the organization/brand.

columns.name: brand_id
columns.description: Unique ID of the organization/brand.

columns.name: owner_user_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for a specific user who owns this.

columns.name: project_category
columns.description: Project category of the survey. Allowed values - CORE, CX, EX, BX, PX

columns.name: project_type
columns.description: Type of Qualtrics project. Match pattern = ^[a-zA-Z]+$

columns.name: scoring_summary_after_questions
columns.description: Boolean representing whether the scoring summary is after questions.

columns.name: scoring_summary_after_survey
columns.description: Boolean representing whether the scoring summary is after the survey.

columns.name: last_activated_at
columns.description: The date and time the survey was last activated; follows the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

columns.name: last_modified_at
columns.description: The point in time when the record was last modified; follows the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.description: Boolean representing whether the record was soft-deleted in Qualtrics.

columns.name: owner_email
columns.description: Email of the USER who owns the object.

columns.name: count_questions
columns.description: Total number of questions (does not include deleted ones) in the survey. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_survey_responses
columns.description: Total number of survey responses. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_completed_survey_responses
columns.description: Total number of completed survey responses (ie is_finished=true). Set to 0 if NULL.

models.name: qualtrics__contact
models.description: Detailed view of contacts from both the XM Directory and (to-be-deprecated) Research Core contact endpoints, enhanced with response and mailing list metrics.

columns.name: contact_id
columns.description: The ID for the contact.

columns.name: is_xm_directory_contact
columns.description: Boolean representing whether the contact came from the XM Directory API endpoint (ie stored in the directory_contact table).

columns.name: is_research_core_contact
columns.description: Boolean representing whether the contact came from the (to-be-deprecated) Research Core API endpoint (ie stored in the core_contact table).

columns.name: email
columns.description: The user's email address.

columns.name: email_domain
columns.description: Domain of the contact's email address.

columns.name: first_name
columns.description: Contact's first name.

columns.name: last_name
columns.description: Contact's surname.

columns.name: external_data_reference
columns.description: The external reference for the contact.

columns.name: language
columns.description: The user's default language.

columns.name: mailing_list_ids
columns.description: Comma-separated list of mailing list IDs the record is associated with, sorted in ascending order of mailing list ID.

columns.name: count_mailing_lists_subscribed_to
columns.description: Count of distinct mailing lists the contact is a member of and has not opted out of.

columns.name: count_mailing_lists_unsubscribed_from
columns.description: Count of distinct mailing lists that the contact has opted out of receiving emails through.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: The creation date and time of the record. If a creation time is not available, the timestamp when the record was last updated is used.

columns.name: count_surveys_sent_email
columns.description: Distinct surveys sent to the contact via email invite. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_surveys_sent_sms
columns.description: Distinct surveys sent to the contact via SMS invite. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_surveys_opened_email
columns.description: Distinct surveys opened by the contact via email invite. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_surveys_opened_sms
columns.description: Distinct surveys opened by the contact via SMS invite. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_surveys_started_email
columns.description: Distinct surveys started by the contact (i.e., has a survey response) via email invite. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_surveys_started_sms
columns.description: Distinct surveys started by the contact (i.e., has a survey response) via SMS invite. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_surveys_completed_email
columns.description: Distinct surveys completed by the contact via email invite. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_surveys_completed_sms
columns.description: Distinct surveys completed by the contact via SMS invite. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: total_count_surveys
columns.description: Total distinct surveys distributed. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: total_count_completed_surveys
columns.description: Total distinct surveys completed. Set to 0 if NULL.

models.name: qualtrics__directory
models.description: A directory is an address book for the entire brand and contains all of the contacts that have been added by your users. This model provides a detailed view of each directory, enhanced with metrics regarding contacts, survey distribution, and engagement.

columns.name: is_deduped_on_email
columns.description: Boolean representing if directory contacts are deduped based on email.

columns.name: is_deduped_on_ext_ref
columns.description: Boolean representing if directory contacts are deduped based on an external data reference.

columns.name: is_deduped_on_first_name
columns.description: Boolean representing if directory contacts are deduped based on first name.

columns.name: is_deduped_on_last_name
columns.description: Boolean representing if directory contacts are deduped based on last name.

columns.name: is_deduped_on_phone
columns.description: Boolean representing if directory contacts are deduped based on phone number.

columns.name: directory_id
columns.description: The directory ID, also known as a pool ID. Example - POOL_012345678901234

columns.name: is_default
columns.description: Boolean representing if this directory is the default one for your brand. The default directory will be the first directory listed in the dropdown menu in Qualtrics.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Name of the directory.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.description: Boolean representing whether the record was soft-deleted in Qualtrics.

columns.name: count_distinct_emails
columns.description: Count of distinct email addresses in the directory. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_distinct_phones
columns.description: Count of distinct phone numbers (stripped of any non-numeric characters) in the directory. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: total_count_contacts
columns.description: Total number of contacts. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_contacts_sent_survey
columns.description: Number of contacts in this directory who have been sent a survey. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_contacts_opened_survey
columns.description: Number of contacts in this directory who have been sent a survey and opened it. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_contacts_started_survey
columns.description: Number of contacts in this directory who have been sent a survey and started the response. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_contacts_completed_survey
columns.description: Number of contacts in this directory who have been sent a survey and completed it. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_surveys_sent
columns.description: Number of distinct surveys sent to contacts. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_mailing_lists
columns.description: Number of mailing lists the exist within the directory. Set to 0 if NULL.

models.name: qualtrics__distribution
models.description: Table of each survey's distribution (method of reaching out to XM directory contacts or Research core contacts) enhanced with survey response and status metrics.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: The creation date and time of the record. If a creation time is not available, the timestamp when the record was last updated is used.

columns.name: header_from_email
columns.description: Email from address.

columns.name: header_from_name
columns.description: Email from name.

columns.name: header_reply_to_email
columns.description: Email reply-to address.

columns.name: header_subject
columns.description: Email subject; text or message id (MS_).

columns.name: distribution_id
columns.description: The unique Distribution ID.

columns.name: last_modified_at
columns.description: The point in time when the record was last modified. Follows the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.description: ID of the organization/brand this record belongs to.

columns.name: owner_user_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for a specific user who owns this.

columns.name: recipient_contact_id
columns.description: The contact ID of the recipient. Can point to directory_contact or core_contact.

columns.name: recipient_library_id
columns.description: Library ID of the message.

columns.name: recipient_mailing_list_id
columns.description: The mailing list or contact group associated with the distribution(s). Can point to directory_mailing_list or core_mailing_list.

columns.name: recipient_sample_id
columns.description: The ID for the desired sample. Can point to directory_sample or core_sample (not included in package).

columns.name: request_status
columns.description: The distribution's status. States include Pending and Done. The Pending state is for email that is scheduled to be sent at a later time.

columns.name: request_type
columns.description: The distribution's type. Types include Invite, Reminder, and ThankYou.

columns.name: send_at
columns.description: The date and time the request will be or was sent (follows the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.). Note that this date and time could be in the future if the email distribution is scheduled to send after a delay.

columns.name: survey_link_expires_at
columns.description: The expiration date for the link associated with the survey distribution. Null if request_type != Invite. Follows the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: survey_link_type
columns.description: The link type (Individual, Anonymous, or Multiple) for the link associated with the survey distribution. Null if request_type != Invite.

columns.name: survey_id
columns.description: The unique survey ID. Will be non-null even if request_type != Invite.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.description: Boolean representing whether the record was soft-deleted in Qualtrics.

columns.name: owner_email
columns.description: Email of the USER who owns the object.

columns.name: owner_first_name
columns.description: First name of the user who owns the object.

columns.name: owner_last_name
columns.description: Surname of the user who owns the object.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_pending
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently pending (the distribution is scheduled but has yet to be sent). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_success
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of success (the distribution was successfully delivered to the contact). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_error
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of error (an error occurred while attempting to send the distribution). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_opened
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of opened (the distribution was opened by the contact). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_complaint
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of complaint (the contact complained that the distribution was spam). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_skipped
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of `skipped` (the contact was skipped due to contact frequency rules or blacklisted contact information). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_blocked
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of blocked (the distribution failed to send, because the contact blocked it or the email was caught by the spam circuit breaker). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_failure
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of failed (the distribution failed to be delivered). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_unknown
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of unknown (the distribution failed for an unknown reason). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_softbounce
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of softbounce (the distribution bounced but can be retried). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_hardbounce
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of hardbounce (the distribution bounced and should not be retried). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_surveystarted
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of surveystarted (the contact started the survey distributed). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_surveypartiallyfinished
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of surveypartiallyfinished (the contact submitted a partially completed survey response). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_surveyfinished
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of surveyfinished (the contact submitted a completed survey response). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_surveyscreenedout
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of surveyscreenedout (the contact screened out while taking the survey). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: current_count_surveys_sessionexpired
columns.description: Count of distributed surveys currently with a status of sessionexpired (the contact's survey session has expired). Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: total_count_contacts
columns.description: Total number of contacts. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_contacts_sent_surveys
columns.description: Count of unique contacts who have been sent surveys via the distribution. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_contacts_opened_surveys
columns.description: Count of unique contacts who have opened surveys via the distribution. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_contacts_started_surveys
columns.description: Count of unique contacts who have started surveys via the distribution. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: count_contacts_completed_surveys
columns.description: Count of unique contacts who have completed surveys via the distribution. Set to 0 if NULL.

columns.name: first_survey_sent_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when the first survey was sent via this distribution. Follows the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

columns.name: last_survey_sent_at
columns.description: Timestamp of when a survey was most recently sent out via this distribution. Follows the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
